description: Assumed completeness of earlier TESS searches, used to discount planets that are probably already known. These are modelling assumptions with citations, not measurements; edit them to test sensitivity.
model: C_prior(SNR) = efficiency / (1 + exp(-(SNR_red - threshold) / width)), with SNR_red the correlated-noise S/N (white S/N / beta); C = 1 - prod(1 - C_pipeline)

pipelines.name: SPOC 2-minute multi-sector
pipelines.reference: Jenkins et al. 2016 (SPIE 9913); Twicken et al. 2018 (PASP 130, 064502): TCE threshold 7.1 sigma

pipelines.name: QLP bright (thoroughly vetted)
pipelines.reference: Huang et al. 2020 (RNAAS 4, 204); Guerrero et al. 2021 (ApJS 254, 39)

pipelines.name: QLP faint-star search
pipelines.reference: Kunimoto et al. 2022 (ApJS 259, 33): multi-sector QLP search to T = 13.5; vetting, not detection, limits completeness
